answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil attacks are resisted by mandating that every new agent identity must lock a sizable slashable stake into a bonded vault at registration. This stake is forged during the dawn phase of onboarding, sourced from a unique entropy seed as hard as a walnut to replicate cheaply. Attackers face linear capital costs that scale with each fake identity, while honest agents earn attestations that unlock the bond over time, making mass identity farming economically irrational.
